messages.text: Hi John, I had a look at the v1 draft of the intro. It is quite long; can you cut it down to two paragraphs? Also, we discussed moving the pipeline figure to section 3, but it is still in the introduction.
yeah i noticed the intro is basically a wall of text. will trim it today. good catch on the fig, moving it to sec 3 now
One more thing: please tone down the use of 'novel'. We describe the method as a new application of existing techniques, not a fundamental algorithmic novelty.
fair point. i was trying to sound confident but i get how it reads as overclaiming. swapping it for 'practical' or just describing the pipeline steps instead
Also, regarding the user study you mentioned: have you checked with the department on ethics approval? I do not want any delays there.
we did. diego told us a short consent form is enough since we are not collecting sensitive personal data, just interest strings and public profiles. i have the template ready
Good. Please attach the consent form to the appendix so reviewers can see it. Let me know if you need help with the wording.
will do, adding it to the end. thanks for the quick feedback, makes a big difference before the freeze tomorrow
